scope: GNUCOBOL binary byte-order primitive probe, not B04 layout acceptance
source:
identification division.
       program-id. binary-probe.
       data division.
       working-storage section.
       01 comp-value pic s9(9) comp.
       01 comp-raw redefines comp-value pic x(4).
       01 native-value pic s9(9) comp-5.
       01 native-raw redefines native-value pic x(4).
       01 byte-number binary-long.
       01 byte-value pic 999.
       procedure division.
           move 16909060 to comp-value native-value
           perform varying byte-number from 1 by 1
               until byte-number > 4
               compute byte-value =
                   function ord(comp-raw(byte-number:1)) - 1
               display "COMP:" byte-value
               compute byte-value =
                   function ord(native-raw(byte-number:1)) - 1
               display "COMP5:" byte-value
           end-perform
           goback.
